description: Invoice details. Dates use the Asia/Almaty time zone.
namesUnavailable: Some names are unavailable or not set. IDs are shown instead. Invoice details remain available.
noFile: The invoice file has not been generated yet
invalidFile: The invoice file URL is invalid. The file cannot be opened.
incomplete: The exact invoice number and amount are unavailable. Payment confirmation is disabled.
confirmBody: Review the invoice and exact amount. Confirm only a payment that has actually been received.
success: The invoice is paid. The current status has been confirmed by the server.
login: Sign out and sign in again
signOutFailed: Could not end the session. Please try signing out again.
notFoundBody: The server did not return this record. Check the URL and access permissions.

errors.not_authenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again to check the current invoice status.
errors.forbidden: The server denied invoice confirmation or reading. This action is unavailable.
errors.not_found: The invoice was not found or is inaccessible. Payment confirmation is blocked.
errors.invalid_status: The invoice status has changed. Another payment confirmation is unavailable; check the current data.
errors.changed: Invoice details have changed or are updating. Close the dialog and review the invoice again before confirming.
errors.unavailable: The payment confirmation service is unavailable. Server configuration needs to be checked.
errors.uncertain: The operation result could not be confirmed. A fresh read has not confirmed payment. Resubmission is blocked; check the invoice status.
errors.refresh_failed: The operation result could not be confirmed: the current invoice status is unavailable. Do not resubmit confirmation. Check the status once the connection is restored.
errors.unverified: The server accepted the request, but Paid status has not been confirmed. Resubmission is blocked. Check the invoice status later.
